name: ZoomInfo
tagline: ZoomInfo is the leading B2B go-to-market intelligence platform, providing verified contact and company data for over 100 million professionals and 30 million companies. Its AI-powered intent data identifies which companies are actively researching solutions in your category — so sales and marketing teams can prioritise outreach at the moment a prospect is most likely to buy. Enterprise revenue teams use ZoomInfo to eliminate cold outreach and focus on accounts showing genuine buying signals.
